title: A variable-offset joint formulation for beams with arbitrary cross-sections using a null space method
summary: In this paper, we present a variational formulation of local configurational constraints that couple multiple beams with arbitrarily shaped cross-sections. Since this formulation requires no explicit interface to rotational degrees-of-freedom, it applies to any beam kinematics and finite element discretization. Here, we define the offset coordinates in a moving frame to constrain or release the relative position between connected beams.
